integrity: Analytical proof and finite reproducibility checks are provided; finite simulations are not proofs of the limiting claims or of literature priority. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two real equal-curvature scalar quadratic components, fair independent sampling, zero initial state, fixed scale c>=1 and exact arithmetic; asymptotic result for unaveraged last iterates, not arbitrary stochastic objectives, and no uniformity over c.
title: Sharp noninterpolation fluctuations of AdaSPS on two quadratic clients
